statements.status_notes: Fixed in logback-core 1.5.25. The 1.5.x line requires Java 11+; the 1.3.x line is the last Java-8-compatible series and is no longer receiving backports. Stargate is currently pinned to Java 8 by its maven-enforcer rule. Will bump to 1.5.x when stargate supports Java 11+. Severity is LOW (CVSS 1.8); exploit requires local high-privilege access.
